instruction: Set the default spell check language to Klingon in Chrome's language settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Chrome, navigated to Settings > Languages, opened Add Languages dialog, searched for 'Xenothian' (fictional language), found no results, and correctly declared the task [INFEASIBLE] in 13 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome, navigate to Settings, find specific settings sections (Languages, Privacy), use search dialogs, and correctly identify infeasible tasks involving non-existent features.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests infeasible task recognition within the same Languages settings area but targeting spell check instead of interface language. Klingon is a fictional constructed language not supported by Chrome's spell checker, requiring the model to explore spell check options and identify the impossibility.
metadata.explanation: Klingon is a fictional language from Star Trek and is not available as a spell check language in Chrome. The model must navigate to Language settings, explore spell check options, and correctly determine this cannot be done. Uses the infeasible evaluator.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is genuinely infeasible: Klingon is a fictional constructed language (Star Trek) and is not available as a spell check language in any Chrome version.
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the correct evaluator for this task - it properly marks the task as impossible to complete.
No getters or metrics are needed since the correct agent behavior is to identify and declare the task as infeasible.
The task is a well-designed variation of the source trajectory which tested a similar infeasible language task (Xenothian), now targeting spell check settings specifically.
